title: OneDrive: Create or upload button moves to the right side of the page on the web
summary: The briefing accurately reports the button relocation, affected pages and rollout window in Microsoft's notice. Its licensing explanation is supported, and independent searches found no documented control to retain the previous placement.

claims.where: What's changing; Open questions
claims.claim: No Microsoft Learn page about this button-placement change was found at the time of writing in November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: 'OneDrive "updated placement" "Create or upload"' and 'OneDrive "Create or upload" button placement left right admin setting default rollout'; read OneDrive overview and returned upload documentation. No Learn feature page found; Q&A posts were not official documentation.

claims.where: controls[0].ui and controls[0].api; Governance controls
claims.claim: No tenant admin UI setting or API to retain the previous Create or upload button placement is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'OneDrive "Create or upload" button placement left right admin setting default rollout'; 'Set-SPOTenant OneDrive Create or upload button placement navigation Microsoft Graph setting'. Read OneDrive overview, Set-SPOTenant and Graph sharepointSettings beta; no placement control found.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The OneDrive overview lists Sharing, Sync, Storage limit, Retention, Access control and Notifications as settings managed through the SharePoint admin center.
claims.quote: Many organizations use OneDrive without changing any of the options. To change these settings, use the SharePoint admin center.

claims.where: Governance controls
claims.claim: The settings listed in the OneDrive overview do not document a control over this button-placement change.
claims.quote: Searched: 'OneDrive "Create or upload" button placement left right admin setting default rollout'; read the overview's Manage OneDrive section. Its setting descriptions cover sharing, sync, storage, deleted-user retention, access and notifications, not button placement.
